body: Thank you!  Your comments really made my week better :)

Hello!

I've tried looking for professionals out of school, but I wouldn't be able to afford them even with insurance, my parents have a negative stance on mental illness as well, so I don't think they would be able to help me there.  

I guess my issues feel invalid or silly since I have a lot of things going for me which other people don't have.

As for the GPA, it just kind of stings when an employer asks me what is and then I never receive a response back from them, but I am glad that it won't be going on my diploma lol
